summary: Azar-Marinescu-Steinbaum给出买方势力的结构证据:按DOJ-FTC并购准则,美国平均地理-职业劳动力市场'高度集中',集中度由25分位升至75分位对应挂牌工资下降17%。这为monopsony调和机制提供了前提——若雇主本就压低工资,温和上调可在不减员下逼近竞争工资。

evidence.title: Azar:市场高度集中
evidence.quote: Based on the DOJ-FTC horizontal merger guidelines, the average market is highly concentrated.

evidence.title: Azar:集中度压低工资
evidence.quote: going from the 25th percentile to the 75th percentile in concentration is associated with a 17% decline in posted wages, suggesting that concentration increases labor market power

open_questions: 集中度指标在低薪快餐/零售这类雇主众多行业是否仍成立?
